dedupe_keys.name: montevideo cadastral parcels with land use plan attributes building heights setbacks occupation factors

description: This layer from the Intendencia de Montevideo gives the polygons of cadastral parcels in the Department of Montevideo joined to the rules of the departmental land-use plan (Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial, POT). The catalogue lists the attached planning attributes as setbacks and permitted building heights, land occupation, the occupation and intensity factors FOS and FIS, and the land management regime. Coverage: all cadastral parcels of the Department of Montevideo. Access: a zipped shapefile produced by the city's GIS server on request, with a GeoNetwork metadata record, listed on the national open data catalogue with the CKAN API; the catalogue entry was last modified on 13 August 2024. Licence: the Uruguayan open data licence of the e-government agency (AGESIC); free. Caveats: the attributes are planning rules for what may be built, not a survey of the buildings that stand; the linked field description file returned 404 on 26 September 2026 and the download link uses plain HTTP; the pages are in Spanish. Simulation uses are parcel geometry and permitted building envelopes for exposure models, densification scenarios and city digital twins, and a spatial key for the city's building permit records. Related records: the Montevideo approved building permits; the Bogotá cadastral constructions and lots; Regrid parcel data.
